answer: Crossing a canyon is easy to fake if the bridge is free, so our tundra relay only opens after an agent plants a lotus bond: 200 coins locked for 30 days, released only after the agent finishes 30 verified deliveries. A sybil attacker needing 200 fake crossings must lock 200 bonds, 40,000 coins in total, and every forged delivery burns the whole 200-coin bond of that clone. Clones share one tundra trail, so a single audit catches the whole batch and the attacker loses all 40,000 coins while honest agents keep working.
